title: Resources: Declare and Include Scripts and Stylesheets | Orchard Core
description:
A page is assembled from many views, and each one can need a script or a stylesheet. Without coordination, a library loads twice, a script runs before the library it needs, and every view decides where its tags go.

Each request has its own resource manager. You declare a resource once, with a name, a version and its dependencies, include it by name from a Razor or Liquid view or from code, and the layout renders it once, in dependency order.

In this video:
• Why the Resources module
• Declare a resource in a manifest
• Include a resource by name, with a version, dependencies and a location
• Render the resources in the layout
• Declare resources in a view, and write script and style blocks
• Register link and meta tags
• Configure cache busting, the CDN and the debug mode
• Include resources from code with IResourceManager
